231)༄༅/rdor sems gnas stong gsogs lugs dri med shel gyi mchod rten bzhugs so/kun khyab 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings/ /rol rtsal ma 'gags sgyu 'phra

tei:div.tei:p: rdor sems gnas stong gsogs lugs dri med shel gyi mchod rten bzhugs so/ kun khyab 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings// rol rtsal ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul gar// rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug de la 'dud/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor ras bris sam/ tshom bu gcig gi khar mañdzi'i steng du rnam bum mgul chings dkar po can/ de'i steng du gsang thod khar me long la sindhu ra sa chos 'byung bsnol ma mūm̐ yig dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa bris pas bkab pa'i steng du man shel bkod pa'i mdun nam rgyab tu rtsa gtor dkar zlum/ chos skyong pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ gter gzhi gnyis/ chad brtan bcas/ mdun stegs la bla gtor dkar zlum ril bu zhe gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ drag gtor mtheb skyu nga brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du spro na zhi gtor de 'dra ba zhe gnyis sam bzhi/ drag gtor nga brgyad dam drug de mdun zhi drag mchod pa mjug sprod/ spro na gtor ma brgya rtsa re re bzhin/ sman raka thod snod re re/ cho ga tshar re/ mar me brgya rtsa/ yon chab brgya rtsa/ zhal zas brgya rtsa/ spos brgya rtsa sogs kyang 'du bya'o/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed sdom chog nang gi thub bstod/ jo bshags/ ltung bshags rnams rgyas par gtang*/ tshig bdun/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ spros bral bde chen= 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= gdod nas rnam dag= shes bya kun mkhyen= gter mdzod rgyud 'debs nas/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ tshogs bsags/ mchod rlabs 232) bdag skyed bzlas pa yig drug stong ngam/ sum brgya/ yig brgya brgya'am/ nyer gcig gsol gdab/ nyer bsdu/ mdun skyed bzlas pa/ las sbyor/ bum snyen/ bshags pa dam bca' nyer gcig skong chen lnga/ dag 'gyur bcas/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa'am/ rig me dor/ gnang ba nod/ khrus chog bsang sbyang nas/ rten skyed/ 'gugs pa/ zhib/ phyed ma/ drag po bcas sbyang ba/ til sbyong*/

lha khrus/ rten khrus/ dug sbyong*/ skyabs 'gror gzhug pa bcas/ de nas dbang la/ khrus/ bgegs bskrad/ maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ tshogs bsags/ sdom bzung rgyas pa'am bsdus pa/ sbyor ba sdig sgrib dag byed dbang*/ ye shes dbab rten/ dngos bzhi'i dbang bzhi/ bzlas lung*/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ rjes mchog mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ snga tshogs grol/ slar/ bla ma rig 'dzin= nas/ bdag skyed bzlas pa/ gsol gdab/ nyer bsdu yan/ slar yang bdag skyed/ ma hā shu n+ye ta= nas lan bzhi/ mdun skyed/ skong ba yan/ rig me dor/ khrus chog dbu nas/ dbang bskur gtang rag maṇḍal yan/ slar yang*/ rnam dag gtsang dwangs= 'di ni phyin drug= nyon drug dri ma= phyin drug dri yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis= yig brgya brgya/ 'dod chags= 'di dag= mchog gsum= dkon mchog bden pas= 'byung bzhi= 'byung bzhi= yum chen bzhi= 233) tshe 'das= tshe 'das dkyil 'khor= phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i= dbang khrus bgegs bskrad nas/ bdag 'jug ltar/ gtang rag maṇḍal yan tshar bzhi/ rjes chog mchod bstod dge bsngo bcas/ phyi chog brgyud 'debs/ tshogs bsags nas/ bdag skyed tshar gsum/ mdun skyed skong ba'i mthar/ spro na rol mtsho'i mchod rlabs/ bla ma yi dam spyi gtor/ dam can spyi gtor/ rig 'dzin dga' ston/ bla ma yi dam res mos/ ma mgon lcam dral lam/ chags med sngags srung*/ bdud rtsi kun khyab bam/ yaṃ bskang gnyis/ gter gzhi/ long skabs che na na rag skong bshags/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ spyan 'dren mchod bshags/ skong ba/ bsgral bstab/ sbyor mchod/ tshogs drang ba/ spro na cha gsum/ smon lam/ lhag ma/ gtor bsngo/ gtor 'bul bkra shis bar/ chad tho/ brtan ma/ mchod rlabs/ mchod bstod/ bshags/ brtan/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis/ bzang spyod sogs smon lam ci rigs/ bstan rgyas smon lam/ dngos grub rgya mtsho=

gang du skye ba'i= chos tshul= rgyal ba kun gyi= sa la 'og min= bslab pa gsum= de ltar 'grub pa'ang = gyur cig tshogs nam grol la le'u bdun le tshan re dang*/ chab bkye bsdu/ ja nam gsol la ja mchod tshig bzhi/ gung tshigs rgyas pa bca' 'don/ zhwa ser thams cad nas 'grigs mdzad rgyu 234) sogs dgon nang dang grong chog gang la'ang dge 'dun bcu tshogs yin nas bzung chad mi shor ba bka' drin che/ rigs 'dus rgyal ba 'di 'grub na// rgyal ba thams cad 'grub pa'i phyir// yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i// lam 'dis rang gzhan don byed shog /ces pa'ang rmar shod rgyal ba dgon pa'i nyams bzhes su dpal chen 'dus pas so// dge'o/
